persona: Maintenance planner turned SAP PM functional consultant
resumeText:
Arvind Rao | Visakhapatnam | arvind.rao@example.com

SUMMARY
SAP PM functional consultant with 6 years across steel and power plant maintenance projects.

EXPERIENCE
SAP PM Functional Consultant, Coromandel Infotech Services, Hyderabad (2021 - present)
- Configured functional locations, equipment categories and maintenance order types for an S/4HANA asset management rollout at a steel plant.
- Built task lists and SAP maintenance plans for strategy-based preventive maintenance on 3,000 pieces of equipment.
- Mapped breakdown and corrective maintenance processes as-is and to-be with the maintenance planning team.
- Loaded equipment and functional location master data through LTMC templates during cutover.
- Integrated maintenance orders with MM reservations and purchase requisitions for spare parts.

Maintenance Planner, Godavari Power Ltd, Visakhapatnam (2019 - 2021)
- Created maintenance notifications and work orders in SAP PM for the boiler and turbine sections.
- Tracked MTTR and MTBF for critical pumps and reported them every month.

SKILLS
SAP PM, SAP EAM, S/4HANA, MM integration, Excel

EDUCATION
BTech Mechanical Engineering, Andhra University, 2019
